## Upgrade Your Workspace Before June 30 and Get Rewarded

EOFY is one of the smartest times of year for businesses to invest in their workplace.

Budgets are being finalised. Teams are planning for growth. Offices are evolving. And many businesses are looking at the new financial year asking the same question:

Is our workspace actually supporting the way we work?

To help businesses move before June 30, Your Office Space has partnered with Experienced Office Furniture (EOF) to launch a limited-time EOFY Cashback Promotion.

For every qualifying furniture purchase between now and EOFY, businesses will receive a BONUS VISA Gift Card:

- Spend $10,000 → Receive a $100 VISA Gift Card
- Spend $20,000 → Receive a $200 VISA Gift Card
- Spend $50,000 → Receive a $500 VISA Gift Card

Simple. Practical. Rewarding.

## Why Businesses Are Investing In Their Workplace Again

Over the past few years, many offices have become reactive.

Businesses downsized.
Teams went hybrid.
Furniture purchases were delayed.
Meeting rooms became storage rooms.
Old workstations kept getting "another 12 months".

But now businesses are realising something important:

Your workplace directly impacts productivity, culture, staff retention and client perception.

The businesses attracting good people are creating environments where teams actually want to work.

That does not always mean spending millions on a full fit out. Sometimes it means:

- Replacing outdated workstations
- Creating collaborative meeting areas
- Improving ergonomics
- Upgrading breakout spaces
- Standardising furniture across teams
- Making the office feel intentional again

## Commercial Furniture That Actually Lasts

One of the biggest mistakes businesses make is purchasing residential-grade furniture for commercial use.

It looks good online.
It arrives flat packed.
And 18 months later it is wobbling, peeling or failing.

Commercial furniture is built differently.

Experienced Office Furniture has been manufacturing and supplying commercial furniture solutions across Australia for decades, supporting:

- Offices
- Schools
- Government
- Defence
- Healthcare
- Commercial fit outs

The difference is durability, compliance, support and long-term value.

## Planning a New Office or Relocation?

If your business is:

- Relocating offices
- Expanding
- Renewing a lease
- Refurbishing a workplace
- Hiring staff
- Reconfiguring for hybrid work

…this is the ideal time to start planning.

At Your Office Space, we help businesses with:

- Tenant representation
- Workplace strategy
- Office space planning
- Furniture specification
- Fit out project management
- Delivery and installation

The goal is simple: Create a workplace that works commercially, operationally and culturally.

## EOFY Timing Matters

Most suppliers become extremely busy in June.

Lead times tighten.
Installations book out.
Budgets get rushed.
Decisions get delayed until it is too late.

Businesses that move early generally get better outcomes, smoother delivery and more control over the process.

## Limited Time Offer

The EOFY Cashback Promotion is available for qualifying purchases completed before June 30.

If you are considering upgrading your workplace this financial year, now is the time to have the conversation.

Because the right workplace is not an expense.

It is an investment in how your business performs every single day.

To discuss your upcoming office project, furniture upgrade or workspace strategy, contact Your Office Space.
